'''Rurrk Ca'rivv''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] operating during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The bounty hunter tried to deceive the Empire and collect the bounty on [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] by disguising a dead [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] to make it appear like the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Ca'rivv did this by stripping the Jawa of its clothing and surgically modifying it to make it appear to be Yoda. Unfortunately for Ca'rivv, the smell of the dead Jawa alerted the Empire to the ruse. As a result of Ca'rivv's actions, the Empire decided to raise the bounty for a live capture of Yoda by 30,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], and implemented a policy to prevent any similar fraudulent actions from occurring again. This new policy imposed a penalty of [[Death/Legends|death]] for any attempts of fraud by future bounty hunters.<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This bounty hunter's only mention is in Yoda's databank entry in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''.
